headline: Bank of Japan Governor Ueda signals upside risks to inflation
summary: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda stated that the central bank expects underlying inflation to remain near its 2% target but acknowledged potential upside risks. Rising energy costs are contributing to accelerated price growth.
why: The Bank of Japan's monetary policy stance is a critical factor for global liquidity and the valuation of the Japanese Yen.

impacts.name: Japanese Yen
impacts.why: Expectations of higher inflation and potential rate hikes typically strengthen the currency.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Comments regarding upside inflation risks suggest the central bank may consider tightening monetary policy sooner than previously anticipated.
